reviews.title: Great price for great quality! BIG!!
reviews.comment: Easy to set up and way bigger than I imagined. Picture quality is great and I love the menu and options it has. Samsung is always a winning my book. With the curve and size of the screen it's kinda intimidating coming from a smaller Amazon basics screen. I am glad I got it though!
reviews.author: Deriq Dooley

reviews.title: Great deal
reviews.comment: Looks brand new and works perfectly! Zero complaints.. Beautiful picture for a qhd monitor.....shipping was super fast and box was in perfect condition. My buy a second one soon!
reviews.author: George from AZ
